text:
Priya S: Quick heads-up — planning to push runtime v3.5.2 to prod on 2026-04-02 at 18:00 UTC. I'm the deploy owner. No DB schema changes. Window ~30–35m. Need smoke leads and rollback readiness.
Alex M: I'll take smoke lead for the default lane. Will run perf/latency and sanity prompts.
Ken R: I can watch infra/metrics + autoscaling, and stand by for capacity adjustments. Please ping if we need more nodes. :thumbsup:
Samira: I'll handle the functional smoke tests (health endpoints + a handful of sample prompts). Can we formalize the quick checklist here?
Priya S: TL;DR checklist: 1) Canary 2min -> 2) 5min ramp -> 3) Full lane flip. Quick checks: health, p95, error-rate, kv-cache hit-rate, and a couple of sample queries. Rollback plan: flip feature flag back to v2, scale down new pods, revert image tag if needed.
Taylor: Runbook link updated: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy (see 'fast-rollback' section). Also added the perf baselines.
Alex M: Can you paste the curl checks we should run? I'll script them for the smoke run.
Samira: Sure — quick commands to run during canary:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":8}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
# check p95: Grafana -> /dashboards/runtime-p95 --> time window last 15m
```
Ken R: I'll keep an eye on cluster CPU/GPU and the autoscaler. If p95 > baseline+50ms or error-rate > 1%, call rollback.
Priya S: Canary plan: beta-1 lane at 18:00 for 2 minutes (owner Samira), if green -> extend to default lane 5 minutes (owner Alex). Final flip if stable.
Alex M: Affirmative. I'll post results in this thread after each step.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Priya S for 2026-04-02T18:00Z (runtime-v3.5.2). Window 00:35:00.
Samira: Quick note — I'm provisioning a set of representative prompts to validate hallucination/regression for the new runtime. Will share sample responses here.
Priya S: Approvals: @Alex M, @Ken R, @Samira please confirm ok by 17:45 UTC so we can proceed. Also leaving rollback owner as Alex M.
Alex M: OK from me.
Ken R: OK.
Samira: OK.
Priya S: Great — final reminder 17:55 UTC we'll do the final go/no-go ping. If anything unexpected shows up, we'll abort and follow rollback steps. Thanks everyone.
